summary: Learn risk-based food purchasing, supplier approval and chain-of-custody controls. Build practical records for audit readiness. Enquire today.
lede: Food-safety supplier assurance applies hazard-based controls to sourcing, receipt, storage and transport. For food procurement officers, supplier-quality specialists and food-safety managers, it develops practical ways to tier supplier risks, set approval evidence and acceptance criteria, and link hazard analysis with receiving checks and traceability records. Exercises use supplier files, temperature logs and lot-tracing scenarios, with overview-level coverage of ISO 22000:2018, ISO 22005:2007 and GS1 traceability concepts.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who select food suppliers, set acceptance criteria, review food-safety evidence or control products after delivery. It suits people who already work in food procurement, quality, food safety, warehousing, catering or food-sector auditing.
prerequisites: Relevant work experience in food procurement, supplier quality, food safety, warehousing, catering or food-sector auditing is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Exercises use food-safety records and spreadsheet-based trackers; existing spreadsheet access is sufficient.
